cues: The ovaries make oocytes and the hormones oestrogen and progesterone.

text: The female system. The ovaries make oocytes and the hormones oestrogen and progesterone. Finger like fimbriae of the Fallopian tube sweep the released egg in, and fertilisation happens in its widest part, the ampulla. The uterus, with its lining the endometrium, receives the embryo.
